rows.evidence: Q1: Materials and methods <U+2014> three-season field trials (1997-1999) at Tel Amara, Bekaa, with drip/fertigation vs macro-sprinkler treatments, 15N microplots, tensiometers, neutron probe and tensionics soil-solution extractors at 30, 60 and 80 cm. Q2: Nitrate leaching evaluation section and Figure 6 <U+2014> significantly higher nitrate concentrations under sprinkler below the roots (60 and 80 cm), while fertigation and drip treatments showed a steady, very low level at 80 cm and nitrate restricted within the root zone (40 cm); estimated N leached beyond root zone <3 kg/ha under drip vs 55 kg/ha under macro-sprinkler; Conclusions restate that drip treatments showed no vertical nitrate movement. Q4: Fertilizer use efficiency section <U+2014> soil head potential at 0-30 cm under sprinkler stayed between -175 and -100 mbar, profile wet to full bed width; sprinkler described as a one-dimensional flow pattern with relatively more water (39%) taken from the 30-60 cm layer (neutron probe) and weak fluctuation of head potential at 60 cm indicating deeper water penetration <U+2014> i.e. the water-flow/percolation pathway through which the leaching difference arises was measured.
rows.notes: Leaching was assessed with a single method (tensionic soil-solution extractors); the kg/ha leached estimate combines those same concentrations with literature-based irrigation efficiency assumptions rather than an independent measurement, so Q3 is no. Single site, single clay soil, single crop/cultivar (Spunta); plots up to 1250 m2 on-station, not above field scale. Authors note that the drip effect on nitrate held regardless of fertilizer placement, but state no explicit requirement condition for the leaching reduction (Q7 no). Stated caveats (random sampling variability) concern yield, not leaching (Q8 no). Figure 6 reports means with significance only; no SD/SE/CI for the leaching result (Q9 no).

notes: Full text available; figures not reproduced so Figure 6 error bars cannot be verified. Study directly compares sprinkler (1D wetting) with drip/fertigation for nitrate movement below the root zone in a clay soil in Lebanon.
